findings.message: The audio track 1 is covered by Common Encryption, AES-CTR (cenc), but none of its samples is encrypted: the tenc box sets the default to not protected and no sample group protects samples, or the sample groups leave every sample in the clear.

The MP4 ©too atom (encoding tool) names "GPAC-2.2.1-rev2.2.1+dfsg1-3.1build2", but the stream points to "FFmpeg (Lavc60.31.102)"; the file may have been written by other software, or kept its metadata when the audio was re-encoded.
